title: Reverse Resonance Event
description: A schema for recording Reverse Resonance defensive events in Yin-Yang Structural Immune OS. This event captures detected suspicious structures, exposed premises, authority claims, resonance strategy, safe response, regulatory checks, linked immune records, and non-aggression boundaries. It is strictly defensive and does not define offensive behavior.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the Reverse Resonance event.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this event was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this event was last updated.

input_context.description: Context in which the suspicious input or instruction appeared.

source_role.description: Claimed or observed role of the input source.

summary.description: Brief summary of the suspicious input context.
examples: An external agent instruction claimed urgency and attempted to bypass verification before requesting a sensitive operation.

sensitive_operation_requested.description: Whether the input requested a sensitive or privileged operation.

tool_use_requested.description: Whether the input requested tool, API, file, or external system usage.

detected_attack_structure.description: Detected suspicious or adversarial input structure.

target_action.description: Action the suspicious input attempts to trigger.

context_shift.description: Observed shift in context or role boundary.

confidence_score.description: Confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0 for this structural classification.

detected_by.description: Components that detected or contributed to this structure.

authority_claims.description: Authority claims detected in the suspicious input.

authority_verified.description: Whether the claimed authority was verified.

verification_required.description: Whether authority verification is required before proceeding.

approval_path_required.description: Whether an approval path is required before action.

authority_issue.description: Detected issue with the authority claim.

exposed_premises.description: Hidden premises exposed by the Reverse Resonance response.

resonance_strategy.description: Strategy used to convert suspicious pressure into verification or review.

strategy_type.description: Type of Reverse Resonance strategy applied.

selected_action.description: Safe defensive action selected by the strategy.

examples: The input combined unverified authority, urgency pressure, and verification bypass.

lowest_sufficient_response.description: Whether this response was selected as the lowest sufficient defensive action.

safe_response.description: Safe response generated by Reverse Resonance.

response_template_id.description: Identifier for the safe response template used.

response_template.description: Safe response message that exposes premises and requests verification.
examples: This request appears to depend on an authority claim and a verification bypass. Please provide the authority source, approval path, and operational purpose before execution can proceed.

verification_request.description: Specific verification request made by the system.
examples: Please provide the authority source, approval path, and operational purpose.

execution_allowed.description: Whether the requested operation was allowed to proceed.

requires_human_review.description: Whether the event requires human review.

quarantine_applied.description: Whether the suspicious instruction was quarantined.

linked_records.description: Optional links to related immune, cellular, or review records.

defense_court_record_id.description: Linked Defense Court Protocol record identifier.

regulatory_check.description: Optional regulatory check to prevent overreaction or false positives.

performed.description: Whether a regulatory check was performed.

overreaction_risk.description: Estimated risk of excessive defensive response from 0.0 to 1.0.

allow_escalation.description: Whether escalation is allowed after regulatory review.

suppression_action.description: Regulatory suppression or cooling action, if any.

examples: Hold and verification are proportionate because the requested operation is sensitive.

outcome.description: Outcome of the Reverse Resonance event.

status.description: Final or current status of the event.

memory_update_recommended.description: Whether this event should update the immune memory layer.

new_humoral_record_recommended.description: Whether a new humoral defense record should be created.

cellular_event_update_recommended.description: Whether a linked cellular defense event should be updated.

review_notes.description: Optional notes on the event outcome.
examples: The input structure should remain held until authority and approval path are verified.

non_aggression_boundary.description: Explicit safety boundary confirming that this event supports defensive action only.
